segments.text: Kuala Lumpur, 7 AM. Jalan Tun Razak doesn't move. 500K commuters stare at phones — 'NO ETA.'
Your app is down. Your car is stuck. But your laptop is open.
CRITICAL: routing engine failed past 400,000 concurrent users. All ETAs offline.
Somewhere in that codebase is a fix — and somewhere on this road is a faster lane. Welcome to the sesak.
Construction zone. Whether you drove here yourself or Kiro, your AI assistant, navigated — the fix still needs to be RIGHT.
AI accelerates. You validate. The final call is always yours.
Deploy complete. Version 1430. Routing engine healthy. 500,000 ETAs restored.
Systems online. However you got here — every turn by hand, or Kiro proposing while you decided — the fix is live and the sesak is clearing.
Parallel Bolts complete. Human approved at every gate. And I've recorded your rules for next time.
You didn't skip quality. You didn't skip thinking. You just had the option of a smart partner proposing while you decided. Adaptive. Intelligent. Human-led. That's AIDLC. Selamat, developer.
Deadline exceeded. Board meeting in progress. Routing engine still degraded.
The clock ran out before the fix went live. The traffic outside hasn't moved either.
But you learned the route — you scoped the fix, met Kiro, and found where the express lane starts. Next time, imagine having Kiro from the first turn.
Tomorrow, boss. Tomorrow we take the express lane.
